build_mimov2mtp_model: build a MiMoV2MTP model with config and quantization for next-token prediction
create_mtp_layer: create a MiMoV2MTPLayer with self-attention and MLP for multi-token prediction
load_weights_into_mtp: load checkpoint weights into MiMoV2MTP model with fused qkv projection support
map_model_name_to_mtp_param: map a checkpoint parameter name to the corresponding MTP model parameter name
set_embed_and_head_weights: set embedding and LM head weights on MiMoV2MTP and free CUDA memory
